data.name: Vanilla Armsys
data.shortDescription: Brings the forest Armsy sounds to Armysies in this game and they cut trees.
data.description:
Many of you may remember that in the first game Armysies cut down trees and emit a loud roar from a distance. Those behaviors are absent in the Sons of the forest versions. This mod rectifies that by bringing them back! 

You can customize the following in Mod>Configs:

1. How often the roar sound plays.
2. How loud the roar sound is.
3. How far it can be heard from.

And if you just want the tree cutting or roar, but not the other you can disable the roars and treecutting in the config options. 

Multiplayer

Purposely disabled client side in multiplayer games to prevent gameplay disruption. I haven't tested if it works in multiplayer yet. But its probably works client side if the host. Ill look into adding multiplayer syncing in the future.

Note: This mod doesn't make them spawn earlier. Use VailSpawnControl or Raid Customizer for that.
